messages:
sarah_support: Customer ACME GmbH (EU) uploaded a resale certificate but billing is stuck — system shows OCR mismatch and tax flagged. ticket #34567. attaching screenshot: https://files.redwood.test/34567/screenshot.png

mike_billing: can you paste the exact validator output?

sarah_support: pasted from vat-bot below. customer says they provided signed resale cert PDF. they also said they need PO + reverse-charge on invoice or payment will be delayed.

vat-bot: ```
vat-checker v2.1
result: INVALID
reason: OCR_PARSED_VAT=DK123456789 -> expected DE123456789
doc_confidence: 0.41
parsed_issue_date: 20-10-2023 (unparsed format)
missing_fields: buyer_name_language
```

mike_billing: OCR mismatch looks like country code misread (DK vs DE). could be scan quality. ask customer for the original PDF (not photo) and a short selfie of signer? otherwise finance needs manual review.

oliver_sales: FYI ACME is on an enterprise contract. They insist reverse-charge is correct; they provided the resale cert from their legal. Sales needs this cleared today if possible.

anya_finance: Checklist for manual VAT exemption: 1) resale cert must show buyer name + VAT ID + seller identification 2) VAT ID must match VIES or gov record 3) doc must be signed/stamped or come from company letterhead 4) issue date must be before invoice date. If any parsing fails we still can accept with human review but need the raw PDF and a signed statement.

sarah_support: customer uploaded a scanned PDF, I downloaded it: https://files.redwood.test/34567/resale_cert.pdf (looks like a low-res scan). they say the VAT ID printed is DE123456789 but bot read DK.

mike_billing: can you request the following from customer: original PDF or higher-res scan, a short note from their finance confirming VAT ID (email header intact), and the PO number they want on invoice. also ask them to confirm company name exactly as on VAT registry.

sarah_support: done, requested docs at 10:12 CET. customer replied with a photo of the paper at 10:42 CET — still low quality. they asked if we can "just flip VAT off" for now so they can pay.

anya_finance: we can do a manual override but need to attach the override reason and who approved. I'll accept a scanned PDF if it's legible. If VIES lookup passes we can set tax_exempt=true. Provide the VIES link and decision in the ticket. Also need business justification for audit trail.

mike_billing: internal command to flip tax flag once finance signs off: `billing-cli invoice update --id INV-2025-123 --tax_exempt true --note "manual override: resale cert on file, decision by anya_finance"`

oliver_sales: I'll ping the customer to resend the original file and an email from their CFO. keeping on them. :phone:

sarah_support: update 11:30 CET — customer uploaded a new PDF (higher-res). I ran it through our parser, vat-bot now:```
vat-checker v2.1
result: VALID
vat_id: DE123456789
doc_confidence: 0.87
parsed_issue_date: 2023-10-20
```

anya_finance: I reviewed the PDF and VIES. VAT ID DE123456789 is valid and matches ACME GmbH. Manual override approved. I'll annotate the invoice and push to billing.

mike_billing: applied override and updated invoice INV-2025-123. billing system note: "tax_exempt=true via manual review by anya_finance, supporting doc saved (file id 34567)". customer notified.

sarah_support: customer confirmed payment went through after we issued VAT-free invoice. closing ticket. :white_check_mark:

oliver_sales: great job team — please add a short KB on steps for OCR false-positives so CS can triage faster.

anya_finance: will add KB items: required artifacts, sample phrasing to request new PDF, and internal override workflow. ETA EOD tomorrow.

mike_billing: tagging this thread for postmortem: improve processor fallback when country code confidence < 0.5.

sarah_support: noted. closing internal thread.
